'''Deron Cadoruso '''was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] who lived during the [[Galactic War]]. He and his Mandalorians joined with the [[Order of Revan]] when [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] returned during the [[Galactic War]]. In honor of the friendship and loyalty between [[Canderous Ordo|Mandalore the Preserver]] and Revan, Deron and his warriors wore [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] that was in the image of the Mand'alor. During the [[Battle of Yavin 4 (Galactic War)|Battle of Yavin 4]], he and his men were [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the fighting.

==Behind the scenes==
Deron Cadoruso appeared as one of the bosses in "Temple of Sacrifice" in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', in the [[2014]] Digital Expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan|''Shadow of Revan'']].

Deron's name is an anagram for [[Canderous Ordo]].
